name: Ben Armstrong
rootCause: ZenGo CEO Ouriel Ohayon tweeted that BitBoy Crypto founder Ben Armstrong's Twitter account was hacked and used to promote a crypto scam to steal users' NFT assets, the same scam that hit garry tan, peter schiff and others, asking users to be aware of the risks involved.
